title: Google Built a Monopoly on Search Defaults and Will Do It Again in AI
partialText: In August, DuckDuckGo filed an amicus brief agreeing that Google unlawfully maintained a monopoly in violation of the Sherman Antitrust Act.

title: Google broke the law. It's paid no price. Congress can change that.
partialText: Nearly two years since a judge ruled Google an illegal monopolist. Total changes Google has had to make so far: zero. That's what getting away with it looks like. The SEARCH Act can end it now.

title: Watch YouTube Without Ads on the DuckDuckGo Browser
partialText: DuckDuckGo now blocks most video ads! Use our free browser to get the full YouTube experience, minus the ads. YouTube Ad Blocking joins our powerful lineup of browsing protections that manage cookie pop-ups, protect you from invasive tracker-based web ads, and more.

title: DuckDuckGo's New Pro Plan: 2x AI Limits, More Advanced Models
partialText: The DuckDuckGo subscription now comes in two plans: Plus and Pro. The new Pro plan is for people who use AI for demanding tasks. On top of our VPN and other protections, it includes 2x higher usage limits than Plus, exclusive access to Claude Opus 4.6, and the highest reasoning available on Duck.ai.

title: 2025 DuckDuckGo Charitable Donations: $1.1M to privacy and digital competition non-profits around the world
partialText: DuckDuckGo is donating $1,100,000 in 2025 to support organizations that share our vision of raising the standard of trust online.

title: The DuckDuckGo subscription now includes more advanced AI chat models, along with VPN & more
partialText: Access more advanced AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and others in Duck.ai as part of the DuckDuckGo subscription, formerly called Privacy Pro.

title: Try Privacy Pro for 7 Days with New Free Trials
partialText: Since launching our Privacy Pro subscription service, we've worked hard to make features like the DuckDuckGo VPN more powerful and easier to use.

title: The DuckDuckGo Browser: Fresh New Look, Same Great Protections, AI Optional
partialText: Redesigned icons, a softer interface, a fresh color palette, and interactive elements to show you exactly how DuckDuckGo is protecting you.

title: DuckDuckGo Browser’s Scam Blocker Expands to Include Protection from More Threats
partialText: The DuckDuckGo browser’s built-in Scam Blocker guards against phishing sites, malware, and other common online scams. It’s free, anonymous, and on by default, so you’re protected as soon as you open the browser.

title: Private, Useful, and Optional AI: DuckDuckGo offers free access to popular AI chatbots at Duck.ai and expands AI-assisted answers on its search engine
partialText: DuckDuckGo’s approach to AI is to provide private, useful, and optional AI features – including chat and search instant answers – to people who want the productivity benefits of AI without the privacy risks.

title: 2024 DuckDuckGo Charitable Donations: $1.1M to support digital rights, online privacy, and a better Internet ecosystem
partialText: DuckDuckGo is donating $1,100,000 in 2024 to support organizations that share our vision of raising the standard of trust online.

title: Roadblocks to Competition: Investigate Google’s Non-Compliance with the EU’s Digital Markets Act
partialText: DuckDuckGo calls on the European Commission to launch three non-compliance investigations around Google’s obligations under the EU’s Digital Markets Act (DMA).

title: Investing in privacy-respecting companies that are raising the standard of trust online
partialText: With the core objective of supporting consumer privacy technologies, DuckDuckGo is now actively investing in early-stage companies as well as pursuing acquisitions and partnerships.

title: Creating Enduring Competition in the Search Market
partialText: As a company that operates a search engine that directly competes with Google, we have several ideas about how to craft a set of legal and technical interventions that can, in combination, effectively curb the advantages Google has gained through illegal use of their search monopoly.

title: DuckDuckGo AI Chat: anonymous access to popular AI chatbots
partialText: DuckDuckGo AI Chat is an anonymous way to access popular AI chatbots – currently, GPT 3.5 Turbo,  Claude 3 Haiku, and open-source models Llama 3 and Mixtral 7x8B, with more to come. This optional feature is free to use, within a daily limit.
